name: brain-remote
description: Remote brain access for Claude Code sessions without a local clone: registers your self-hosted brain MCP server (deployed from tools/brain-remote). Needed only where no claude.ai connector reaches the session (plain CLI, headless, no connectors); if `claude mcp list` already shows `claude.ai brain-remote` (a mirrored claude.ai connector), skip it and let Claude pass bootloader: false instead.

brain_remote_url.title: Brain MCP server URL
brain_remote_url.description: The full URL printed by tools/brain-remote/setup.sh — https://<host>/mcp/<secret>. The secret path IS the credential; it is kept out of settings.json — in the macOS Keychain, or ~/.claude/.credentials.json elsewhere.
